tests.title: Course page only lets customers book upcoming sessions and books the chosen one
tests.goal: Past session dates cannot be chosen, and the enrolment is on the date the customer picked.
preconditions: A visible QA course with a weekly Fixed timetable
data: QA course 3200 or another found at runtime

steps.text: Open the course page on the eShop
Click a past session date in the calendar (shown with is_passed)
Pick the timeslot and click Apply
Check out (Bank Transfer) and open the enrolment in the CRM Status List

expected.text: Past dates are disabled, or Apply is refused with a message
If a date is accepted, the enrolment and cart show that same date

checks.label: Past dates are disabled, or Apply is refused with a message
If a date is accepted, the enrolment and cart show that same date

notes: Picked 21 Oct and 14 Oct; both enrolled on 4 Nov.

tests.title: Expired eGift cannot be reserved and the customer is told why
tests.goal: An eGift outside its reserve period is refused with a visible message and no points are taken; error responses do not expose server internals.
preconditions: An eGift whose reserve period has ended (e.g. /egift/detail/8 Nice meat, /egift/detail/9 testA)

steps.text: Open the expired eGift detail page by URL
Check the page, the member points and E-Gift Redemption Record

expected.text: A message says the gift is out of its reserve period (or Reserve is disabled)
No points are deducted and no reservation is created
The API response contains no stack trace or server paths

checks.label: A message says the gift is out of its reserve period (or Reserve is disabled)
No points are deducted and no reservation is created
The API response contains no stack trace or server paths

notes: No message; points untouched; response has a stack trace (BUG-016).

Re-checked 2026-10-27 from the saved screenshot: the page does show a toast "Gift out of reserve period" (bottom right). The check only looked for modals and missed the short-lived toast. BUG-015 withdrawn; no points were taken, so the case passes.

tests.title: Member places a home-delivery order and staff deliver it
tests.goal: Home delivery checkout applies the shipping method rules and the order can be packed and dispatched to Complete.
data: Delivery method 香港本地送貨; region/district/area chosen at runtime

steps.text: Select JD while the total is below HKD 1,000 and read the message
Select 香港本地送貨, fill Region, District, Area and Address, Bank Transfer, tick 結帳前同意, Proceed
Upload a receipt; in the CRM accept it
Delivery > Pack All > Save > Dispatch > OK

expected.text: JD shows "available for orders between $1000.00 ~ $3000.00 ... does not meet the requirement"
The CRM order shows the delivery method, region, district, area and address
After dispatch the order, payment and delivery status are Complete and Inventory History shows DELIVERED -1

checks.label: JD shows "available for orders between $1000.00 ~ $3000.00 ... does not meet the requirement"
The CRM order shows the delivery method, region, district, area and address
After dispatch the order, payment and delivery status are Complete and Inventory History shows DELIVERED -1

notes: JD refused at HKD 700 with the 1000-3000 message; fee HKD 0 for 到付 and 香港本地送貨. TXN0126102700024: CRM shows 香港本地送貨, Kowloon / Kwun Tong District / Kwun Tong and the address; accept -> Processing; Pack All > Save > Dispatch -> Complete 19:35; Inventory History DELIVERED -1 at TaiPo.
